assets.name: Rally Oak
assets.scale_status: Suggested art-direction bounds, not measurements of the image. All are visible dimensions above nominal ground; any buried skirt is extra.
assets.silhouette: A broad umbrella canopy over a stout, gently leaning trunk.
assets.features: Three structural branches; five to seven canopy masses; broad root flare.
assets.collision_recommendation: Simple trunk capsule or tapered convex proxy; canopy generally nonblocking.
assets.animation_recommendation: Pin trunk base; allow modest branch-tip and canopy sway.
assets.modeling_notes: Keep limb junctions readable. Do not model every leaf; use irregular rounded clusters with broad facets. Match crown volume rather than exact leaf-cluster count between views.
assets.pivot: At ground contact center, Z=0; root flare/rocks may extend a small skirt below ground.
assets.coordinates: +X right, +Y rearward from the front reference, +Z up; meters. Export conversion is engine-specific.

variation.note: These are suggested placement ranges. Keep silhouette proportions; do not freely randomize nonuniform scale. Check tree lean, rock notch direction, and camera visibility.

assets.name: Switchback Pine
assets.scale_status: Suggested art-direction bounds, not measurements of the image. All are visible dimensions above nominal ground; any buried skirt is extra.
assets.features: Four staggered canopy tiers around a narrow visible trunk.
assets.collision_recommendation: Simple trunk capsule; omit fine foliage collision.
assets.animation_recommendation: Pin trunk base; sway upper tiers progressively more.
assets.modeling_notes: Avoid a mathematically perfect cone. Make each tier asymmetric, with chunky edges. Preserve the four-tier silhouette when reducing detail.

assets.name: Turbo Palm
assets.scale_status: Suggested art-direction bounds, not measurements of the image. All are visible dimensions above nominal ground; any buried skirt is extra.
assets.silhouette: A curved segmented trunk and a broad radial crown.
assets.features: Eight to ten substantial fronds; no fruit.
assets.collision_recommendation: Two or three simple capsules following trunk curve; fronds nonblocking.
assets.animation_recommendation: Keep crown attachments fixed; bend fronds along their length.
assets.modeling_notes: Use a few broad notches per frond. Model frond thickness at close range. Keep consistent lean direction between front and side views.
assets.pivot: At ground contact center, Z=0; root flare/rocks may extend a small skirt below ground.
